body:
CONCRETE ASSET MAP against approved docs candidate 76c62e7. The thin page does not need invented demos: eight receipted program/output pairs already map directly to a front-loaded tour. InspectSource -> SurfaceAtlas/TextSpan evidence; ModelAStory -> entities/situations/contexts/claims/relations plus StoryContextFigure; RepresentRecall -> checked RecallGraph; UseEmbeddings -> typed batch outcomes/receipts/policy; PublicAlignAndInterpret -> GraphHsmm posterior plus AlignmentMassFigure; SummarizeRecall -> RecallSignature/support plus RecallSummaryFigure; ScoreInterview -> AI counts/placement/profile plus InterviewScoreFigure; SaveModel -> canonical StoryModelCodec/checksum/version refusal. Each card can show 8-15 lines of the existing exact program, 3-6 exact output lines, one plain-language consequence, and the full-page link.

WHAT THE EXISTING ASSETS CANNOT YET SHOW, so the successor should not pretend otherwise: AlignmentMassFigure shows P but not transition flow F; there is no source-atlas, recall-graph, or embedding-output visual; proposition charts and AMR interop appear only as module names; acquisition resolution is not demonstrated; SaveModel is canonical model JSON, not the still-pending multi-outcome output bundle. Highest-value new executable/visual additions after the content regroup are therefore (1) a P-plus-F flow view with external/Unranked textual twins, (2) a small proposition-chart/PENMAN-adapter example that states AMR is an adapter and the runtime is not yet qualified, and (3) a typed acquisition partial-outcome example. All remain pure HTML/CSS and local; no JavaScript or external resources.
